subject: Post-demo: VitalAI follow-up — prompt/output storage and retention options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@vitalai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: VitalAI follow-up — prompt/output storage and retention options

Hi Linda,

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our demo and the options we discussed around prompt and output handling so your security team can validate next steps: 

- Default behavior (self-serve / hosted):
  - Prompts and model outputs are processed transiently by the inference runtime. Raw prompt text is stored in ephemeral buffers and not persisted to long-term storage by default.
  - Short-lived runtime logs (request/response hashes, latency metrics) are retained for 7 days for debugging and autoscaling analysis.

- Optional persistence modes (enterprise / Dedicated / Private deployments):
  - Session captures: customers can opt into storing full prompts and outputs to a customer-controlled bucket for audit or retraining; retention TTL is configurable (e.g., 30, 90, 365 days or custom).
  - Derivative artifacts (embeddings, summaries): can be routed to customer-managed storage or redwood-managed storage with per-tenant residency controls.

- PII controls discussed:
  - Pre-send redaction hooks: customer can run a preprocess plugin (customer-side) to mask fields before requests leave their environment.
  - Server-side PII scrubbing: optional pipeline that redacts detected fields before persistent storage; configurable sensitivity.
  - Hashing: when customers prefer, we store only deterministic hashes of prompt identifiers rather than raw text.

- Residency & keys:
  - Hosted US/EU regions available; Dedicated and Private support bringing your own KMS keys (HSM/KMS integration) so stored data is encrypted under keys you control.

Attached are a compact privacy matrix and a one-page summary of data handling to share with your security team.

Action items I propose:
1) Confirm VitalAI's desired default for hosted trials (ephemeral-only vs. trial captures).
2) Kimberly and Rishi to provide a short attestation template we can sign regarding retention windows and encryption.
3) If VitalAI needs specific residency (EU-only), flag it now so we scope trial region.

If it's helpful I'll get a distilled one-page attestation for your legal/security team early tomorrow.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: privacy-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-data-handling-summary.pdf (one-pager)

From: Linda Park <linda.park@vitalai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: VitalAI Security <security@vitalai.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: VitalAI follow-up — prompt/output storage and retention options

Thanks Sergio — helpful summary. A couple of clarifications from our side after a quick sync with our Security lead: 

- For the pilot we need: prompts not persisted in Redwood-managed storage (ephemeral-only) unless we opt in.
- If we opt in later for captures, retention must be configurable and we need the ability to set 365-day TTL as a maximum for PII-containing prompts.
- Any telemetry that contains identifiers (user_id, email) must be hashed before being stored in analytics logs.
- Residency: pilot must run in US-East (we will evaluate EU later).

Can you confirm Redwood can enforce ephemeral-only by default for our org id and supply a formal note saying telemetry retention is 7 days for hosted trials? Also please include whether Redwood's hosted service supports customer-managed KMS for the pilot or if that requires Dedicated/Private.

Linda
Head of Product | VitalAI

On Tue, Oct 7, 2025 at 11:02 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: VitalAI follow-up — prompt/output storage and retention options

Hi Linda — great to meet you over video earlier. Pulling together the concrete answers you asked for below; I attached the short attestation template as a PDF as well.

1) Ephemeral-by-default for pilot: yes — we can provision your org id with a policy that marks hosted trial traffic as ephemeral-only. That means no prompt text or outputs will be written to redwood-managed durable storage for the duration of the pilot. Transient runtime buffers and anonymized request metrics (latency, error codes) will still be retained for 7 days.

2) Retention if you opt into captures: we support configurable TTLs per-capture-policy. For PII-containing captures, we can enforce a maximum retention of 365 days at the org level and flag any request exceeding that TTL for review.

3) Hashing telemetry: we provide an ingest-time transform that replaces configured identifiers with deterministic salted hashes before they are written to any analytics or logs. This can be enforced at the tenant policy level.

4) KMS & residency: customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest is currently available for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted trials we offer encryption using Redwood-managed keys; if you require BYOK for pilot we can explore a short-term Dedicated evaluation or field a strict encryption carve-out with our infra team (this would take a bit longer).

Next steps we recommend:
- Sergio to request ephemeral-only trial provisioning (I can approve).
- VitalAI to confirm whether they need BYOK for pilot or if Redwood-managed keys are acceptable for 30-day trial period.
- We will get you a signed attestation PDF stating: ephemeral-by-default on pilot, 7-day telemetry retention for hosted trial, hashing available for identifiers.

Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security Policy | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-attestation-template.pdf

From: Linda Park <linda.park@vitalai.com>

- Please include the attestation as a one-page signed PDF we can attach to the procurement packet.
- Confirm there will be no export of raw prompts to Redwood analytics during the pilot (only hashed identifiers and anonymized metrics).

If you can send the signed attestation and a short note on the KMS timeline/options (Dedicated evaluation ETA) I'll get procurement engaged.

Thanks,
Linda
